seo.title: Cookie Policy
seo.description: Learn how diBoaS uses cookies to improve your experience and analyze site traffic.

header.title: Cookie Policy
header.notice: Updated on November 25, 2026: we now list what the site keeps in your browser, the signup forms have a separate box for noting which link brought you, and a "Cookie settings" button lets you change your choice.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us remember your preferences and understand how you interact with diBoaS.

cookiesWeUse.title: Cookies We Use

essential.title: Essential Cookies (Required)
essential.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function. You cannot opt out of these.

rows.purpose: A copy of your cookie preferences that your browser can read, so the banner does not appear again

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies (Only After Your Consent)
analytics.description: These cookies are only set after you click Accept on the consent banner. Before consent, no analytics cookies exist on your device. We use Google Analytics and PostHog to understand how visitors use our site. We do not send them the name or email address you give us. If you accept, they also receive which campaign link brought you to our site and, when you sign up, which button brought you to our waitlist. Separately, the waitlist forms have an unticked box that lets us note which button or campaign link brought you to our waitlist: until you sign up this is kept only in the open tab and never saved on your device, and it is saved with your signup only if you tick the box.

rows.purpose: Google Analytics — distinguishes users (only after consent)
Google Analytics — session identifier (only after consent)
PostHog analytics — session tracking (only after consent)
Google Analytics: keeps the state of your current visit

cookiesWeUse.signupRecords: Whatever you choose, a signup records which signup form you used, your country (worked out from your connection or, when it can be guessed, from your browser's language) and, if you sign up through a form on the site's pages after opening a friend's invitation link in the same browser tab, or you typed their invite code, that friend's code (see our Privacy Policy).

storage.title: Other storage on your device
storage.intro: Besides cookies, the site and its analytics tools keep these items in your browser's storage. Items kept for the tab are deleted when you close it.

rows.purpose: Keeps a friend's invitation code from the link you used
rows.when: When you open an invitation link

rows.purpose: Keeps the waitlist figures so the page does not ask for them again
rows.when: On pages that show the waitlist

rows.purpose: Keeps the email you entered so you do not type it again
rows.when: When you sign up to open your Money Jobs plan
rows.keptUntil: You clear this site's data, or you delete your signup in this browser

rows.purpose: The site's latest technical messages, with personal details removed, kept on your device to help find errors
rows.when: When the site records a technical message, before any choice

rows.purpose: PostHog analytics, session recording included; while analytics is on, its session data includes the page you came from (from our own pages, only our site's address; from another site, what that site shares)
rows.keptUntil: In your browser's storage until you clear this site's data or turn analytics off; the cookie copy up to a year; the tab-only items when you close the tab

rows.purpose: Remembers whether you turned analytics off after accepting it
rows.when: When you decline, or accept again, after accepting; at every accept if your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control

storage.prefixNote: diboas-cookie-consent, diboas_ref and diboas_waitlist_email take the site's storage prefix; the other names are fixed.
